text:
jamie: quick check-in — launching an experiment on the non-chat embeddings endpoint. switching batch formation from fixed-window (N tokens or 100ms) to sampled-pooling with soft token budget=1024 and window=60ms to favor smaller requests. goal: reduce tail without starving throughput.

olivia: nice. can you paste the policy config? curious how priority interacts with the reranker queues

jamie: pasted:
```
queue_policy: sampled_pooling
soft_token_budget: 1024
max_batch_latency_ms: 60
priority: [small, normal, large]
fairness: true
kv_cache_prefill: true
```

raj: kv_cache_prefill true helps hot keys, but watch KV eviction pressure — sampled pooling tends to mix sizes so KVC may thrash if slice sizes vary.

sara: also add probe for kernel selection: force int8 kernel on canary nodes to see perf impact with these batch shapes. earlier we saw kernel switch at avg_seq=512 causing +40ms.

jamie: good call — will pin int8 on canary and collect per-kernel token latency. perf-bot, enable per-kernel profiler for thread 1839991234-canary

perf-bot: profiler enabled, sampling=100ms. will post aggregated metrics in ~15m :hourglass:

olivia: what success metrics? 95th latency drop >= 100ms without throughput drop >2% and no regression in embedding quality

jamie: yep. also watching GPU utilization and queue depth. if KV eviction > 5% we abort.

raj: quick note — if we see increased stall events in kernel scheduler, fall back to fixed-window for large batches. add fallback rule in rollout

jamie: rollout plan: canary 10% traffic -> monitor 30m -> escalate to 50% if metrics good -> full. will post results here

perf-bot: canary report ready: 95th latency -88ms, p50 -12ms, throughput +0.8%, KV eviction 2.1%, kernel-switch events down 18%.

sara: looks promising. next: run longer-run 6h stability test and run evals on embeddings to ensure no quality drift

olivia: thanks team — let's sync after 6h with charts. :thumbsup:
